choices.label: Nano S Plus
choices.description: Compact USB device with a clearer screen than the original Nano S. A common choice for computer-connected cold storage.
choices.subtitle: USB · Secure Element

nodes.body: Coldcard devices are air-gap oriented and Bitcoin-focused. Mk4, Mk5, and Q differ mainly in keyboard, display, and workflow comfort.

choices.label: Mk4
choices.description: Established Coldcard with numeric keypad and strong air-gap workflows (PSBT via SD). Widely documented for multisig and dice entropy.

choices.label: Mk5
choices.description: Newer Mk-series Coldcard when available in your channel. Confirm current Coinkite naming and firmware before purchase.

choices.label: Coldcard Q

choices.subtitle: Full keyboard · QR

nodes.title: Which Bitkey product?
nodes.body: Bitkey is a mobile-first self-custody design. Understand the 2-of-3 recovery model before you fund it.

choices.label: Bitkey device
choices.description: Block’s Bitkey pairs a hardware key with your phone app. Spending uses a 2-of-3 arrangement across the device, the phone, and a Block recovery server — there is no traditional BIP39 seed phrase to write down. Take the recovery and server-dependence model seriously before large balances.
choices.subtitle: Hardware + phone · seedless 2-of-3

nodes.title: How will you generate the Ledger seed?

choices.label: PIN only

choices.label: Skip extra protection

choices.label: Add computer/keyboard entropy

choices.label: Device RNG

choices.label: Metal backup then wipe device

nodes.body: Receiving needs a correct address on the right network, shown from keys you control. Verify on a trusted screen; treat xpubs and clipboards as sensitive.

nodes.title: How will you send bitcoin?
nodes.body: Sending authorizes a spend. Prefer offline / PSBT flows for large amounts; always verify destination and amount on a trusted signing surface.

choices.label: Air-gapped / PSBT signing

choices.label: Connected hardware wallet
choices.description: USB/Bluetooth hardware signs while a companion app builds the tx. Confirm destination on-device every time.

choices.label: Hot wallet / connected app
choices.description: Phone or desktop wallet signs online. Convenient for small amounts; malware and clipboard rewrite are primary risks.
